title: Prepay Bookings Taken against a Signed Request on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
A prepay booking taken against a signed request the member has lodged is taken at the ceiling the programme will carry where the member has asked for more than that, and the member books it in their own name.

A booking taken that way is a money commitment against the product the request names and carries no booked unit price of its own, so a delivery drawn against a booking that carries no booked unit price is priced at the list in force on the day it leaves the plant, while a delivery drawn against a booking that does carry one is priced at that booked price.

The money the cooperative will take on a prepay booking is fixed only after the account's ledger carries the volume discount earned on the input spend of the crop year just closed.

## Taking the booking

The booking is taken with `book_prepay_commitment_189dfe27`, which is the member's own tool: the desk unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, so the money is taken in in the member's own name. One call books a single prepay line, and the money named is held to the member's credit on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts, to be drawn against deliveries of the named product as the season runs.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | The internal reference number identifying the crop input account the prepay is held on, taken from the crop input account record pulled up for this member before the call | An id |
| `order_id` | The internal reference number identifying the signed prepay request the member lodged with the agronomy desk that this booking answers, taken from the agronomy request records pulled up for this member before the call | An id |
| `product_name` | The product the money is committed against, taken from the member's own words in this conversation | Copied character for character, keeping their wording, digits and punctuation, with nothing translated, normalised, summarised, added or removed |
| `booking_amount` | The money taken in on this booking | USD to 2 decimal places, a positive figure, rounded half away from zero to the cent at the moment of the call; there is no empty-value form and no currency symbol is passed |

### The return

A confirmation sentence in plain text, carrying the prepay line's own internal reference, the booking number raised for it in the shape BK- followed by six digits, the product the money is committed against and the money taken in, in USD to two decimal places. That sentence is what indicates the prepay has been taken and is standing to the member's credit; no other acknowledgement follows.
